title: Wicked Wedding Night
summary: A bride is shot with a spear gun and falls off a balcony.
method: Due to the blinding sun at that time of the day, the killer mistook the identity and shot the wrong person. They later strangled the intended victim. They masked the sound with a blender. The killer had white gloves so their fingerprints didn't show up on the spear gun.
motive: They liked the maid and was upset that they were with someone else.
